message.content: The core risk is the fp16 round-trip of the state at every one of 512 steps. Quick math: h converges to ~b/(1-a) ≈ 10, fp16 ulp near 10 is ~0.0078 (rounding error ~0.004 per step), and the 0.999-contraction gives an error steady-state std of roughly 0.004/√(2·0.001) ≈ 0.09 per element — implying E ≈ 0.09·128/1280 ≈ 0.009, potentially ~3× the 0.003 budget. This is directly in scope and needs a runtime probe.

message.reasoning_content: Record the main claim: fp16 rounding every step may exceed E ≤ 0.003. Quick analysis: steady state ~ b/(1-a) with b~0.01 → h ~ 10. fp16 ulp at 10 is ~0.0078 (2^-11 ~ relative 5e-4, ulp = 0.0078). Error per step e_t = 0.999 e_{t-1} + rounding ~ random with std ~ 0.002-0.004. Steady state std ~ rounding/sqrt(2*0.001) ~ 0.004/0.045 ~ 0.09. RMS error per element ~0.09; ||err|| ~ 0.09*128 = 11.4; ||ref|| ~ sqrt(16384*100)=1280. E ~ 0.009 — exceeds 0.003! Strong suspicion. Record claim.
